ayahs.en: By the dawn
And [by] ten nights
And [by] the even [number] and the odd
And [by] the night when it passes,

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِيۡ حِجۡرٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr
ayahs.en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍۙࣕ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad
ayahs.en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
[With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

ayahs.ar: الَّتِيۡ لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي الۡبِلَادِۙࣕ‏
ayahs.tl: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad
ayahs.en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

ayahs.tl: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad
ayahs.en: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
[All of] whom oppressed within the lands
And increased therein the corruption.
So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

ayahs.ar: فَاَمَّا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكۡرَمَهٗ وَنَعَّمَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَكۡرَمَنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman
ayahs.en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا٘ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَهَانَنِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan
ayahs.en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

ayahs.tl: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem
ayahs.en: No! But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
And you love wealth with immense love.

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا٘ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الۡاَرۡضُ دَكًّا دَكًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka
ayahs.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -

ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa
ayahs.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

ayahs.ar: وَجِايۡٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ࣢ۙ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ وَاَنّٰي لَهُ الذِّكۡرٰيؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa
ayahs.en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

ayahs.tl: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad
ayahs.en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

ayahs.tl: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad
ayahs.en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
And enter among My [righteous] servants
And enter My Paradise."
